name: _Radio Option
description: Private renderer for one native radio option inside Radio Group. It owns local indicator, label, optional description, and native option state while the parent Radio Group owns the single selected value.

props.name: label
props.description: Required option label content associated with the native radio input.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional explanatory content associated to the native radio through aria-describedby.

props.name: name
props.description: Shared native radio-group name supplied by the parent.

props.name: value
props.description: Required unique native radio value supplied by option data.

props.name: checked
props.description: Private checked state derived from the parent Radio Group selected value.

props.name: required
props.description: Native required state applied consistently to every radio in a required group.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Private callback from the native radio change event to the parent Radio Group.

representations.mapsTo: native input:checked derived from Radio Group value

anatomy.name: radio-input
anatomy.description: Native type=radio input providing selection, focus, keyboard, disabled, required, and form semantics.

anatomy.name: indicator
anatomy.description: Decorative 20px radio circle and selected dot driven entirely from the native input state.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible option name within the native label target.

anatomy.name: description
anatomy.description: Optional consequence/detail text that wraps and grows vertically.

states.name: selected
states.description: Presentation derives from the native checked state passed by Radio Group.

states.name: hover
states.description: Option-row hover presentation is CSS-derived while enabled.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Focus-ring presentation derives from the native radio focus-visible state.

states.name: pressed
states.description: Pressed presentation is CSS-derived from active pointer/keyboard interaction.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Native radio disabled state is supplied per option.

semantics.accessibleName: The visible option label owns the native radio accessible name.
semantics.keyboardActivation: native radio behavior; no custom keyboard state machine
semantics.focus: native radio focus with a CSS-derived visible focus ring
requirements: The native radio remains the semantic and focusable control even when its visual circle is custom styled.
Description presence derives Figma showDescription; no showDescription prop exists.
Selected presentation derives from the native checked state; no selected visual prop exists.
Hover, focus, and pressed presentation are browser/CSS-derived; no state prop exists.
A selected option that later becomes disabled remains selected; disabled never clears checked state.
The option row is an understandable label target and description content is associated through aria-describedby.
The private helper must never create a public React package export.

content.description: Private option anatomy controlled by Radio Group; consumers cannot compose arbitrary children into it.
